xna-type.name: NetworkSessionJoinException
xna-type.summary: Thrown if an error was encountered while joining a session.

constructor.summary: Creates an empty instance of NetworkSessionJoinException.
Creates an instance of NetworkSessionJoinException with the specified error message.

parameters.parameter: A message that describes the error.

constructor.summary: This constructor is available only when developing for Windows.
constructor.syntax: protected NetworkSessionJoinException ( SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context )

parameters.parameter: Describes information related to the session being joined when the exception occurred.
Describes the stream where the exception occurred.

constructor.summary: Creates an instance of NetworkSessionJoinException with the specified error message and inner exception.

parameters.parameter: A message that describes the error.
The inner exception related to this exception.

constructor.summary: Creates an instance of NetworkSessionJoinException with the specified error and additional information on the exception.

parameters.parameter: A message that describes the error.

property.name: JoinError
property.summary: Gets or sets a more detailed description of the session join failure.
property.value: Contains information about the session join failure.

method.name: GetObjectData
method.summary: When overridden in a derived class, returns information about the exception. In addition to the base behavior, this method provides serialization functionality.

overload.summary: When overridden in a derived class, returns information about the exception. In addition to the base behavior, this method provides serialization functionality.

parameters.parameter: Information necessary for serialization and deserialization of the session item.
Information necessary for the source and destination of a given serialized stream. Also provides an additional caller-defined context.
